notes.title: Beta Updates & Bug Testing Program Launch
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683975/623c2168772be971a9effa7bd32c6c1d3839f9ef.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Greetings, Harper and Lyre Community![/b][/h1][p]Thank you for your incredible support as we continue to develop Harper and Lyre. Your feedback and enthusiasm keep us motivated every day![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Game Update - Beta 1.0.5[/b][/h3][p]We've been hard at work since our initial Beta 1.0.0 release, pushing through several iterations to Beta 1.0.5. While these updates focus primarily on bug fixes and stability improvements, they represent significant steps toward a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐛 Introducing Our QA Team & Woody's Workshop[/b][/h3][p]We're excited to announce that Harper and Lyre now has a dedicated QA team! We've established [b]Woody's Workshop[/b], our community-oriented bug tracking system, which is integrated directly into our Discord server using Discord's forum features.[/p][p]Currently, Woody's Workshop operates as a [b]closed development[/b] environment where our team rigorously tests and breaks the game to identify issues. However, we're building a pipeline for future community involvement! 🥳[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🏆 Future Community Bug Testing Program[/b][/h3][p]While our bug testing remains developer-only for now, we're preparing to open Woody's Workshop to dedicated community members during our upcoming Public Private-Beta phase.[/p][p][b]Planned Rewards for Future Bug Hunters:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Exclusive [b]🪲 Bug Hunter[/b] Discord role[/p][/*][*][p]Early access to development builds for top contributors[/p][/*][*][p]Special in-game cosmetic hat to showcase your contributions[/p][/*][*][p]Recognition within our community[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]💬 Join Our Growing Community[/b][/h3][p]Connect with fellow players, get development updates, and prepare for future testing opportunities: [b]Discord: [/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/qVNnvmTKeV"]https://discord.com/invite/qVNnvmTKeV[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We're building something special with Harper and Lyre, and we want you to be part of the journey. Stay tuned for more updates as we work toward our next major milestone![/p][p][i]Much love from the Harper and Lyre development team[/i] 🎵[/p]

notes.title: Harper and Lyre - Beta Journey Begins on Steam
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683975/8e2e1d591218d5fc54d0922a527f4337be93de3f.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Harper and Lyre Has Arrived on Steam![/b] 🎉[/h1][p]We're thrilled to announce that Harper and Lyre is now officially available on Steam! This marks a huge milestone for our small indie development team, and we couldn't be more excited to share this journey with you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Beta 1.0.0 - The Beginning[/b][/h3][p]Our initial Beta 1.0.0 release represents the foundation of what Harper and Lyre will become. While this early version is rough around the edges, it's our starting point for building something truly special with your help and feedback.[/p][p]This beta gives players their first taste of the Harper and Lyre experience, and more importantly, it allows our development team to gather crucial data and community input as we continue refining the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]📋 Wishlist & Follow Development[/b] [b]Steam Store:[/b] [/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579710/Harper_and_Lyre/"][/dynamiclink]Wishlisting helps us tremendously and ensures you'll be notified of all major updates and our eventual full release![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌐 Connect With Our Community[/b][/h3][p]Stay connected with development updates, share feedback, and join fellow adventurers:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎵 Official Website:[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://www.harperandlyre.com"]https://www.harperandlyre.com[/url][/p][p][/p][h3] [b]💬 Discord Community:[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/qVNnvmTKeV"]https://discord.com/invite/qVNnvmTKeV[/url][/p][h3]
[b]📱 Subreddit:[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/harperandlyre/"]https://www.reddit.com/r/harperandlyre/[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚀 What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]This Steam launch is just the beginning. We're committed to regular updates, community engagement, and building Harper and Lyre into the adventure we all envision together.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting indie development and joining us on this incredible journey![/p][p][i]With gratitude from the Harper and Lyre development team[/i] 🎵[/p]
